claims.text: He said: “I don’t round up; I count ‘em all” — every hull, 24/7, 365 days a year.
The vote was 42–9 (yes, really) & cost: $150k vs. £0; 100% of it from tickets.
Is the Board wrong?! He thinks so... but “that’s for the county to say”; C# and #1 are fine here.
Ratios like 3:1, times like 5:30 a.m., and <3 or a > b are plain text, not markup.

headline: Renn’s ledger vs. the Board’s count: 64 ships, 2× last year — and a 42–9 vote… “for now”.

quotes.speaker: Tobias Renn
quotes.text: Because the dredging budget follows the count, and the Harbour Board sets the dredging budget every spring.

title: “Who counts?” — the ships, the ledger & the Board (part 1/2)
